doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/26
doc_title_jp: 業績予想の修正及び配当予想の修正(増配)に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 長期的視野に立った投資実施と経営成績・財務状況を勘案し、配当性向目標35%以上の方針に基づく

summary_en: Annual dividend raised from 19 yen to 26 yen per share (+37%) for FY3/26 (ended Aug 2026). Payout ratio target 35%+. Revision reflects upgraded earnings guidance: operating profit +28.1% to 4,100M yen, net income +22.2% to 3,300M yen, driven by strong semiconductor equipment market demand.
summary_jp: FY3/26通期配当を19円から26円に引き上げ（+37%）。配当性向目標35%以上。好調な半導体製造装置市場を背景に営業利益28.1%増、純利益22.2%増に上方修正。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - FY3/26 - 26 yen/share (19→26 yen, +37%) - payout ratio 35%+
